description: 开源下载管理器（Rust + egui）：多线程加速、BT/磁力、yt-dlp/gallery-dl/m3u8 抓取、Debrid 支持，IDM 的替代品。
post_install: $target = "$persist_dir\native-host\com.misterdownloadmanager.host.json"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $target) | Out-Null; $exe = Join-Path (Split-Path $dir -Parent) 'current\misterdownloadmanager-nmhost.exe'; [pscustomobject]@{ name = 'com.misterdownloadmanager.host'; description = 'Mister Download Manager browser integration host'; path = $exe; type = 'stdio'; allowed_extensions = @('integration@misterdownloadmanager.com') } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -Path $target -Encoding ascii

$cid = 'oogbclbbninliongijffeeggalppliok'; $ctarget = "$persist_dir\native-host\com.misterdownloadmanager.host.chromium.json"; [pscustomobject]@{ name = 'com.misterdownloadmanager.host'; description = 'Mister Download Manager browser integration host'; path = $exe; type = 'stdio'; allowed_origins = @("chrome-extension://$cid/") } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -Path $ctarget -Encoding ascii
pre_uninstall: foreach ($k in @('HKCU:\Software\Google\Chrome\NativeMessagingHosts\com.misterdownloadmanager.host', 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Edge\NativeMessagingHosts\com.misterdownloadmanager.host', 'HKCU:\Software\Chromium\NativeMessagingHosts\com.misterdownloadmanager.host', 'HKCU:\Software\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\NativeMessagingHosts\com.misterdownloadmanager.host', 'HKCU:\Software\Vivaldi\NativeMessagingHosts\com.misterdownloadmanager.host')) { if (Test-Path $k) { Remove-Item -Path $k -Recurse -Force } }; Remove-Item -Path "$persist_dir\native-host\com.misterdownloadmanager.host.chromium.json" -Force -ErrorAction Ignore
notes: 便携版：下载列表与设置保存在安装目录的 data 子目录（已 persist），程序自身不写注册表。
已随安装注册 Firefox / LibreWolf 原生消息宿主：host manifest 放在 persist 的 native-host 子目录，HKCU 下 Mozilla 与 LibreWolf 两处注册表键指向它，扩展装好后弹窗显示「已连接到 Mister Download Manager」。
Firefox / LibreWolf 扩展：https://addons.mozilla.org/ 搜 Mister Download Manager，要求 Firefox 140+。

Chromium 系（Chrome/Edge/Chromium/Brave/Vivaldi/Opera）：另写一份 allowed_origins 版 host manifest（扩展 ID 由 extension\chromium\manifest.json 的 key 算出为 oogbclbbninliongijffeeggalppliok），登记各自 NativeMessagingHosts 键；扩展可从 AMO/Chrome 商店装，或用安装目录 extension\chromium 手动加载。
misterdownloadmanager-mcp.exe 为 MCP 服务端，misterdownloadmanager-cli.exe 为命令行抓取工具，均已加入 PATH。
